description: D9 (operator, 2026-10-26): every non-major update of this repo arrives as ONE weekly
'routine updates' PR, merged with /ship after its CI and dev check. FIRST on purpose: the
family groups and holds below override it, so lockstep families and approval-gated packages
keep their own PRs. Security fixes are never grouped (vulnerabilityAlerts).
D9: a major update waits for its box to be ticked on the Dependency Dashboard and then gets
its own session and plan (/updates lists it; it never rides in the routine PR).

packageRules.description: MinIO AIStor uses non-semver RELEASE.<ISO8601> tags. Map year->major, month->minor, day->patch and the time as build so newer releases sort higher. ⚠ HELD BEHIND DASHBOARD APPROVAL since 2026-10-10: from RELEASE.2026-09-19 the Free tier refuses every write to a bucket with SSE-S3 configured (all our backup buckets) and stores other writes in plaintext (tested with our licence, CLAUDE.md § Object store). Renovate lists new releases on the Dependency Dashboard and opens a PR only when ticked there. pinDigests keeps the @sha256 in sync.

`requires-python` is set by hand, never by Renovate. It is the laptop floor (`>=3.10`; manage.sh builds its venv with `uv venv --python 3.11`). With `rangeStrategy: bump` Renovate's pep621 manager raised it to `>=3.14.8` in #180, which made the project unresolvable for that venv on a fresh clone.

`.python-version` (the interpreter `uv run` / `uv sync` pick for the tests; manage.sh builds its own 3.11 venv) is held below 3.15, like kube-infra's CI Python (kube-infra#1580) and cluster-agent's image: PyYAML 6.0.3, its newest release and a direct dependency here, ships no cp315 wheel, so on 3.15 uv builds it from source with unpinned build tools (#217, held 2026-10-24). EXIT: lift this when PyYAML publishes cp315 wheels (yaml/pyyaml#981).
